text:
sam: Heads up — multiple Dedicated customers in ap-east are reporting 429s + placement failures. Several support tickets escalated (SUP-8891, SUP-8894). Looks like autoscale didn't add nodes and some requests fell back to hosted (billing spike).

jess: Which dedicated pool? pool id?

sam: pool=ded-ap-east-02, shard=3. Queues started piling around 13:22 UTC. Support bot alert attached.

support-bot: ALERT ap-east: dedicated-pool/ded-ap-east-02 capacity=0 queued=62 fail_rate=0.28

jess: pulling placement logs now — seeing repeated "allocate_device: no free GPUs" and k8s evictions. Also this in scheduler:
```
2026-08-13T13:22:31Z ERROR scheduler: allocate failed: DeviceUnavailable: device busy by tenant=team-alpha
2026-08-13T13:22:34Z WARN autoscaler: scale_up skipped: recent_scaling=true cooldown=300s
```

aria: autoscaler cooldown hit because of a burst 5m earlier. Policy has cooldown=300s and max_step=2, so it throttled the scale. We should be able to force a scale now.

mike: Customer billing: a handful of requests dropped to hosted fallback and got billed at on-demand rates; legal loop-in from support. Need mitigation ASAP to avoid more chargebacks.

luis: Repro steps from customer attached:
1) POST /v1/dedicated/generate with model:redwood-13b-q2
2) 429 with body: "region_capacity_unavailable"
3) Retry -> routed to hosted -> success but at higher cost

jess: also seeing auth errors for some tokens when routing — 401s from token service intermittently while fallback was happening. Stack shows:
```
HTTP 401 token-service: failed to decrypt KMS key: KMS_DECRYPT_TIMEOUT
```

aria: KMS region was healthy; suspect transient latency combined with autoscale policy caused both placement and auth timeouts. Two separate cascades.

deploy-bot: rollout "autoscaler-tuning" (commit: 9f3b2a4) deployed to ap-east 2h ago. Changed cooldown from 120s -> 300s and lowered max_step from 4 -> 2.

jess: that rollout likely intended to stabilize thrash but unintentionally reduced responsiveness under sudden bursts. Proposal:
- immediate: manually trigger emergency scale to +6 GPUs in ded-ap-east-02 (aria)
- short term: temp rollback cooldown -> 120s (deploy back) (jess/infra)
- restrict heavy tenants: throttle top noisy tenants for 30m (mike/support)

aria: running scale command now: `infractl scale pool ded-ap-east-02 --gpus +6 --reason emergency` — will update.

aria: scale triggered, new nodes provisioning. watching placement queue.

sam: support notified customers about active remediation. Ticket SUP-8891 updated.

luis: customer confirms some requests are flowing again but one reported a 503 trace id: 8f1c. They're asking for root cause explanation.

jess: root cause summary for now: autoscaler tuning deployed earlier reduced scale headroom; burst + noisy tenant consumption exhausted pool; autoscaler cooldown prevented timely scale; KMS latency led to auth timeouts during failover; fallback to hosted caused billing increases.

mike: action owner list: aria=manual scale + monitoring; jess=rollback autoscaler config; luis=support comms + billing triage; sam=exec summary for CSMs. We'll follow up in 2 hours.

support-bot: NOTE: queued=8 after scale, placed=44 recovered, alert cleared at 13:34 UTC :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all. please paste postmortem links here when ready.
